# Shreyansh Kabra

> Software Engineer based in Los Angeles, CA. Backend & cloud engineer building scalable, observable systems — from edge-to-cloud platforms and distributed caching to LLM & RAG applications.

This site is a single-page portfolio rendered with React. The files below contain the same content as plain Markdown.

- [Full profile](https://kabrashrey.github.io/shreyansh_kabra/llms-full.txt): about, experience, projects, skills and education in one file

## Projects

- [Artist Search – Web App](https://github.com/kabrashrey/artsy-search): Full-stack app integrating Artsy API to explore 100K+ artists. JWT auth, MongoDB, deployed on GCP with perfect Lighthouse scores.
- [Artist Search – Android App](https://github.com/kabrashrey/artsy-mobile-app): Native Android app with Kotlin and Node.js backend for Artsy's database. Token-based auth and MongoDB persistence.
- [Portfolio Website](https://github.com/kabrashrey/shreyansh_kabra): Personal portfolio built with React, TypeScript, and Vite. Dark/light mode, responsive layout, and optimized loading.
- [Image Classification – Transfer Learning](https://github.com/kabrashrey/Image-Classification-Transfer-Learning): Image classification using transfer learning with TensorFlow/Keras. Fine-tuned pre-trained model on custom artwork dataset.
- [Police Activity & Weather Analysis](https://github.com/kabrashrey/police_weather_data_analysis): Analyzed 86K+ RI traffic stops with weather data to identify biases and temporal patterns using statistical analysis.
- [Mental Health Signal Detector](https://github.com/Gaurav-Zanpure/group-23-mh-signals): Real-time NLP system classifying support group posts by intent and concern level, with a lightweight RAG module for suggestions.
- [Evidence based RAG for Hallucination-Resistant Multihop Q&A](https://github.com/kabrashrey/hallucination_resistant_multihop_qna): Evidence-based RAG system for multihop question answering, RAG module for suggestions.
